notes: §2002:8.8.4.1.3.3 GR1: a class condition without NOT over a zero-length item is false. g2_class_zero_length exercises the three 2002 zero-length items of §2002:8.5.4: an OCCURS DEPENDING group at N=0 (every class phrase F, NOT ALPHABETIC T), a group of only such an item (F), and an ANY LENGTH formal bound BY CONTENT to that group (ALPHABETIC F, NOT NUMERIC T), with N=2 legs that are not zero-length (ALPHABETIC T through the formal). The arguments are BY CONTENT because BY REFERENCE a variable-occurrence argument has its maximum length (§2002:14.7.1.1), so it is not zero-length (kb/Work PB5621, retired). The DIVERGES record golden-2002-1 first wrote rested on PB5621's retracted premise.
